EVIDENCE_TAG_01
The remember helper appends an item to a supplied list and returns it. Calls without a supplied list must start independent collections. The current helper unexpectedly carries an earlier item into a later independent call. Preserve mutation of an explicitly supplied list.
Observed: remember('a') returns ['a']; a later default remember('b') returns ['a', 'b'].
